quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #12
										  					
  

20 Questions • Passing Score 14

questions.question: Sudden wind gusts on highways can cause problems for:

options.text: Only large vehicles.
Only visibility problems.
All vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: All vehicles.
questions.explanation: Strong wind can affect all drivers. Wind can blow dirt and dust onto the road, reducing visibility. It can also physically push a vehicle sideways. Large vehicles may have extra problems, but all vehicles are at risk.

questions.question: An inattentive driver is someone who:

options.text: Looks at objects off the road or daydreams while driving.
Looks at a passenger instead of the road while driving.
Only watches the vehicle directly ahead.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Do not get distracted by looking at passengers, searching your vehicle, reading, sightseeing, or daydreaming. Always scan the road, check your mirrors, and look at your dashboard regularly. These safe habits help you stay focused while driving.

questions.question: A "No standing" sign means:

options.text: You cannot stop your vehicle there.
You can park there if you stay in the vehicle.
You can stop briefly to pick up or drop off passengers.
You can stop to load or unload goods.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can stop briefly to pick up or drop off passengers.
questions.explanation: A "No standing" sign means you can only stop temporarily to pick up or drop off passengers. You cannot stop for any other reason.

questions.question: When a traffic light shows a green arrow with a red light, you:

options.text: Can only drive straight ahead.
Can only drive in the direction of the green arrow.
Must wait for a solid green light to drive in any direction.
Must stop no matter which direction you want to go.

questions.correctAnswerText: Can only drive in the direction of the green arrow.
questions.explanation: A green arrow with a red light means you can only drive in the direction of the arrow. Make sure the intersection is clear before you drive.

questions.question: Defensive driving means:

options.text: Spotting dangerous situations and acting to prevent accidents.
Passing other drivers to stay away from bad drivers.
Following the car ahead very closely.
Quickly changing lanes and weaving through traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Spotting dangerous situations and acting to prevent accidents.
questions.explanation: Defensive driving means you watch for dangerous situations and take action before an accident happens. This helps you avoid crashes with reckless, careless, or impaired drivers.

questions.question: On a multilane road, a dashed yellow line next to a solid yellow line means:

options.text: No one can pass.
Everyone can pass.
Only drivers next to the dashed line can pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Only drivers next to the dashed line can pass.
questions.explanation: When there is a dashed yellow line and a solid yellow line, only traffic next to the dashed line can cross the center line to pass. Drivers next to the solid line cannot pass.

questions.question: Traffic fines in a construction zone are:

options.text: Doubled.
Tripled.
Cut in half.
The same as usual.

questions.correctAnswerText: Doubled.
questions.explanation: Fines for traffic violations are doubled in construction zones where workers are present. Drive carefully and follow all signs, signals, officers, and flaggers in these areas.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Watch for people crossing the road.
No passing zone.
Work zone ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This orange warning sign alerts you to roadwork ahead. Stay alert and watch for temporary traffic control signs and devices.

questions.question: If oncoming headlights are blinding you at night, you should:

options.text: Look toward the right edge of the road.
Switch your lights to high beams.
Turn your lights on and off.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look toward the right edge of the road.
questions.explanation: If oncoming headlights blind you, look toward the right edge of the road instead of straight ahead. This keeps your vehicle on the road safely until you pass the other vehicle.

questions.question: When driving in traffic, the safest thing to do is:

options.text: Change your speed often to stay alert.
Drive faster than the other cars.
Drive slower than the other cars.
Drive at the same speed as the other cars.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive at the same speed as the other cars.
questions.explanation: Crashes happen when drivers go faster or slower than other vehicles on the road. Always drive at the same speed as the traffic around you, but do not exceed the posted speed limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No right turns.
Right turns are allowed.
Stop before turning right.
Sharp curve ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: No right turns.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means you cannot do something. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: When parking uphill next to a curb, set the parking brake and:

options.text: Keep the rear tires against the curb.
Keep the front tires straight ahead.
Turn your steering wheel away from the curb.
Turn your steering wheel toward the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your steering wheel away from the curb.
questions.explanation: When parking uphill by a curb, turn your steering wheel away from the curb. If your car rolls, it will roll into the curb and stop.

questions.question: Which statement is true?

options.text: Driving too slowly is safe.
Driving too slowly on some highways can be dangerous.
Your speed does not affect safety.

questions.correctAnswerText: Driving too slowly on some highways can be dangerous.
questions.explanation: Driving too slowly can be dangerous. It frustrates drivers behind you, and they may make risky moves to pass. Drive with the flow of traffic at the legal speed limit.

questions.question: When making a right turn, your car should be:

options.text: Near the center of the street.
Close to the left side of the street.
Close to the right side of the street.
Past the center of the intersection when you begin to turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Close to the right side of the street.
questions.explanation: Before turning right, move to the right side of the road. Do not cut across lanes of traffic to make any turn.

questions.question: If you are driving on a highway next to a single broken white line:

options.text: You cannot cross the line to pass.
You may cross the line to pass and change lanes.
You may only cross the line to change lanes if you are in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may cross the line to pass and change lanes.
questions.explanation: Broken white lines separate lanes moving in the same direction. You can cross a broken white line to pass or change lanes if it is safe.

questions.question: If you see animals near the road while driving, you should:

options.text: Speed up to scare them away.
Slow down and proceed with caution.
Quickly swerve into the next lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: Slow down when you see animals near the road. They may jump or change direction suddenly. There may also be more animals nearby that you cannot see.

questions.question: If there is a deep puddle on the road ahead, you should:

options.text: Keep your speed to get through the water.
Avoid the puddle if possible.
Shift into neutral as you drive through the water.

questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid the puddle if possible.
questions.explanation: Avoid slippery surfaces like puddles, ice, wet leaves, and oil. The safest place to drive is on a dry, solid surface.

questions.question: This sign is a:

options.text: Service sign.
Regulatory sign.
Warning sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warning sign.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions ahead, like changes in traffic direction, steep downgrades, or hazards that need your attention.

questions.question: A flashing yellow light at an intersection means you should:

options.text: Slow down and proceed with caution.
Come to a complete stop as quickly as possible.
Stop and proceed only when the intersection is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: At a flashing yellow light, slow down and proceed with caution. You do not need to come to a complete stop.

questions.question: When entering an interstate highway, you should:

options.text: Stop, look for cars, and enter when safe.
Look for cars and slow down to 25 mph before entering the traffic lane.
Look for cars, speed up to match traffic, and merge when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look for cars, speed up to match traffic, and merge when safe.
questions.explanation: Use the acceleration lane to speed up and match the traffic flow. Merge smoothly when it is safe. Do not stop on an interstate.
